Studio Terms & Respectful Use

A few gentle guidelines.

Nothing legal-sounding here, just a clear, honest explanation of how the Studio works, and how we can look after it together.

Welcome

Thank you for supporting Socially Introvert. Your membership is what allows me to keep researching, writing, and refining thoughtful resources for founders who want to build calmer, more connected businesses, so genuinely, thank you for being here.

Our Promise

Do less. Grow more.

Everything inside the Studio is created with one goal: to help you build a business that's easier to find, easier to understand, and easier to grow. Rather than overwhelming you with endless resources, I focus on practical lessons, thoughtful systems, and tools you can return to as your business evolves.

Personal Use License

Access to the Studio is intended for your own individual business. You're welcome to:

  • ✓Build your own business with these resources
  • ✓Adapt worksheets for your personal workflow
  • ✓Apply the strategies to your own projects
  • ✓Learn at your own pace

A Few Kind Requests

To help keep the Studio sustainable for everyone, please don't:

  • ·Share your Studio login with others
  • ·Redistribute, resell, or upload Studio resources elsewhere
  • ·Copy or republish the lessons, guides, templates, prompts, or downloads as your own
  • ·Use the resources to create a competing product without permission
  • ·Share paid Studio content publicly

Team & Commercial Use

If you'd like your team to access the Studio, or you're interested in licensing materials for workshops, teaching, or other commercial use, I'd love to talk it through with you. Just reach out and we'll find the right option together.

Get In Touch →

Copyright

All Studio lessons, templates, downloads, worksheets, guides, visuals, and educational content remain the intellectual property of Socially Introvert, unless otherwise stated.

Why This Matters

Every lesson inside the Studio has been carefully researched, written, and refined to help founders simplify their businesses with confidence. Respecting these guidelines allows me to continue improving the Studio and creating new resources for the community.

Thank you for supporting independent creators, and for helping keep the Studio a thoughtful place to learn. I hope these resources become tools you return to often as your business grows.

Anna

SEO Foundations Audit

Build a website that's easy to understand—for both people and search engines. Find the missing SEO basics that help search engines discover, index, and rank your website.

Estimated time: 15–20 minutes
Perfect for:

Creative founders, makers, and small business owners on Squarespace, Shopify, Wix, WordPress, Webflow, or Showit.

Step 1 of 11

💭 Reflection

Foundations Scorecard

Your SEO Foundations Audit

Diagnosing your website discoverability with zero technical complexity.

SEO Foundations Score
0%
Area Foundations Scoring
Your Top 3 Priorities
1 Fix First

Audit Key Page Titles

Add unique page titles to every core page so search engines and visitors immediately understand what each page is about.

2 Fix Next

Build Connected Internal Paths

Improve internal links by connecting your homepage, services, and blog. This helps both visitors and search engines navigate your site.

3 Then

Optimize Images & Compression

Add descriptive alt text to meaningful images and optimize image sizes for faster loading.

Ecosystem Philosophy

"Small changes, made consistently, create lasting visibility."

You don't need to fix everything today. Choose one improvement, complete it, and let your business become a little more connected than it was yesterday.
